items.question: What is the money, personal-data-and-erasure, and legal/compliance posture (refunds and forfeiture, credits, legal framing) for the advisor?
options: Local only: no money, billing, refunds or credits; job search, notebook and website data stay on the machine; the push carries only wait kind, project and spec; erasure is deleting the home files; no legal framing for a one-operator tool
Send summaries through the push service

items.question: How is a staged action kept from running without the operator's confirmation?
options: A separate advisor credential the confirm route refuses, plus a permission rule that stops the advisor reading the operator secret
The operator secret with a confirm flag

items.question: What does a confirmed staged merge do?
options: Apply the merge rule's checks (green, mergeable, no attribution) and refuse on failure
Merge on confirm with no checks
Merge only through run merge waits

items.question: What shape does a second opinion take on the wait?
options: Typed picks per question plus a short summary; old text advice still renders

items.question: How does the controller send one phone push per new wait?
options: HTTP POST to an ntfy-style URL set in the home
A Claude Code push from a session
